timecoded_text_to_speech.text: And my hope for the Internet is that it continues to grow and penetrate.
We only have 3 billion users we need 7 billion.
We want this to become a safer environment for people, a more trustworthy environment,
and one which becomes a basis for social, economic, governmental, and academic development.
This is a big opportunity for the entire population of the world to become more connected.
I wish that the Internet could become a kind of historical watershed, the beginning of global connectivity.
This will evolve over time. There will be new ways of doing this someday at the Internet.
We'll be replaced by something else better, I hope.
But I hope that that trend simply continues and that we all become a planet of people,

youtube_description:
Vint Cerf gives his wish for the future of the Internet at Global INET 2012, a conference sponsored by the Internet Society, April 22-24, 2012, in Geneva, Switzerland. The conference, titled "Imagining the Future Internet," celebrated the Internet Society's 20th anniversary.

Recorded by a documentary team from Imagining the Internet, an initiative of the School of Communications at Elon University, located in Elon, North Carolina, USA. For complete coverage of Global INET 2012, go to: http://www.elon.edu/e-web/predictions/isoc_20th_2012
youtube_title: Vint Cerf's wish for the future of the Internet
